This is errata version PC-E1 of [[K'lor'slug (V) (Virtual Set 0, Original)]] (version 2 of 3). The current text is [[K'lor'slug (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted with its dated source, in date order; bracketed names such as [Pilot] stand for icons printed on the cards, ▲ is the icon for “take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and ▼ the icon for “deploy from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”.
* '''Original''' ([[K'lor'slug (V) (Virtual Set 0, Original)]]): Players Committee 2014 Virtual Set 0 release<ref name="eh1351-klor-0">[https://www.scribd.com/document/248869355/Star-Wars-CCG-Virtual-Card-Base-Set Players Committee, 2014 Virtual Set 0 Base Set, Light Side Effects (public mirror)].</ref>. Dated 2014 (Virtual Set 0); the day of first publication is not known.{{Mystery|question=On what day was this version of K'lor'slug (V) (Virtual Set 0, Original) first published}} Text: “Deploy on table. If your character in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Non-Jedi, non-[Permanent Weapon] characters may not have their deploy cost modified by Bad Feeling Have I. (Immune to Alter.)” No errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Players Committee Official Errata list<ref name="eh1351-klor-1">[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1dXwBAYCUyBvWHpZc-oSCedmOZUb5f9vSDzUdvV2dUTY/export?format=csv Players Committee, Official Errata list, 16 December 2015].</ref>. First published 16 December 2015. The PC card image with this text and the “E” mark is in the Holotable repository by 8 July 2018 (commit 022435b). Text: “Deploy on table. If your character, starship, or vehicle in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' game text: new or changed words “, starship, or vehicle”, “[Immune”, “Alter]”; the lore now reads “Dejarik of venomous swamp creature from Noe'ha'on. Keen senses of smell and vision. Dangerous hunter. Lays eggs - hundreds of ravenously hungry hatchlings.”; the printed errata mark is now “E” (was “none”). It prints the errata mark “E”.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[K'lor'slug (V) (Errata)]]): Players Committee card image<ref name="eh1351-klor-2">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/klorslug.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022).</ref>. First published 31 July 2022. The Players Committee announced the remastered Virtual Set 0 images on 1 August 2022. Text: “Deploy on table. If your character, starship, or vehicle in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). [Immune to Alter]” '''What changed:''' the words are the same: the printed errata mark is now “E1” (was “E”); the margin title lost its uniqueness dot. It prints the errata mark “E1”. This is the current text.
